content.sanskrit: ईशा वास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥
content.transliteration: īśā vāsyamidaṁ sarvaṁ yatkiñca jagatyāṁ jagat | tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasyasviddhanam ||
content.text:
By the Lord (isa) enveloped must this all be —

Whatever moving thing there is in the moving world.
With this renounced, thou mayest enjoy.

Covet not the wealth of any one at all.

Non-attachment of deeds on the person of a renouncer

content.sanskrit:
कु॒र्वन्ने॒वेह कर्मा॑णि जिजीवि॒षेच्छ॒त समाः॑ ।

ए॒वं त्वयि॒ नान्यथे॒तो॑ऽस्ति॒ न कर्म॑ लिप्यते॒ नरे॑
content.text:
Even while doing deeds here,

One may desire to live a hundred years.

Thus on thee — not otherwise than this is it —

The deed ( karman ) adheres not on the man.

The forbidding future for slayers of the Self

content.sanskrit:
अ॒सु॒र्या॒ नाम॑ ते लो॒का अ॒न्धेन॒ तम॒सावृ॑ताः ।

तास्ते प्रेत्या॒भिग॑च्छन्ति॒ ये के चा॑त्म॒हनो॒ जनाः॑
content.text:
Devilish ( asurya2' ) are those worlds called,3
With blind darkness (lamas) covered o’er !

Unto them, on deceasing, go

Whatever folk are slayers of the Self.6

The all-surpassing, paradoxical world-being

content.sanskrit:
अने॑ज॒देकं॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑यो॒ नैन॑द्दे॒वा आ॑प्नुव॒न्पूर्व॒मर्श॑त् ।

तद्धाव॑तो॒ऽन्यानत्ये॑ति॒ तिष्ठ॒त्तस्मि॑न्न॒पो मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दधाति
content.text:
Unmoving, the One ( ekam ) is swifter than the mind.

The sense-powers ( deva ) reached not It, speeding on before.
Past others running, This goes standing.

In It Matarisvan places action.6

content.sanskrit:
तदे॑जति॒ तन्नै॑जति॒ तद्दू॒रे तद्व॑न्ति॒के ।

तद॒न्तर॑स्य॒ सर्व॑स्य॒ तदु॒ सर्व॑स्यास्य बाह्य॒तः
content.text:
It moves. It moves not.

It is far, and It is near.

It is within all this,

And It is outside of all this.1

content.sanskrit:
यस्तु सर्वा॑णि भू॒तान्या॒त्मन्ने॒वानु॒पश्य॑ति ।

स॒र्व॒भू॒तेषु॑ चा॒त्मानं॒ ततो॒ न वि जु॑गुप्सते
content.text:
Now, he who on all beings

Looks as just (eva) in the Self (Atman),

And on the Self as in all beings — 2
He does not shrink away from Him.3

content.sanskrit:
यस्मि॒न्त्सर्वा॑णि भू॒तान्या॒त्मैवाभू॑द्विजान॒तः ।

तत्र॒ को मोहः॒ कः शोक॑ एक॒त्वम॑नु॒पश्य॑तः
content.text:
In whom all beings

Have become just (eva) the Self of the discerner —

Then what delusion ( moha ), what sorrow (soka) is there,
Of him who perceives the unity !

Characteristics of the world-ruler

content.sanskrit:
स पर्य॑गाच्छु॒क्रम॑का॒यम॑व्र॒णम॑स्नावि॒रशु॒द्धमपा॑पविद्धम् ।

क॒विर्म॑नी॒षी प॑रि॒भूः स्व॑यं॒भूर्या॑थातथ्य॒तोऽर्था॒न्व्य॑द धाच्छाश्व॒तीभ्यः॒ समा॑भ्यः
content.text:
He has environed. The- bright, the bodiless, the scatheless,
The sinewless, the pure (suddha), unpierced by evil (a-papa-
viddha) !

Wise (kavi), intelligent (manisin), encompassing (paribhu), self-
existent (svayambhu),

Appropriately he distributed objects ( artha ) through the eternal
years.

Transcending, while involving, the antithesis of knowing

content.sanskrit:
अ॒न्धं तमः॒ प्र वि॑शन्ति॒ येऽवि॑द्यामु॒पास॑ते ।

ततो॒ भूय॑ इव॒ ते तमो॒ य उ॑ वि॒द्याया॑ र॒ताः
content.text:
Into blind darkness enter they
That worship ignorance ;

Into darkness greater than that, as it were, they
That delight in knowledge.4

Other, indeed, they say, than knowledge!

Other, they say, than non-knowledge ! 5
— Thus we have heard from the wise (dhlra)

Who to us have explained It.0

content.sanskrit:
॥

वि॒द्यां चावि॑द्यां च॒ यस्तद्वेदो॒भय॑ स॒ह ।

अवि॑द्यया मृ॒त्युं ती॒र्त्वा वि॒द्यया॒मृत॑मश्नुते
content.text:
Knowledge and non-knowledge —

He who this pair conjointly ( saha ) knows,

With non-knowledge passing over death,

With knowledge wins the immortal.1

The inadequacy of any antithesis of being

content.sanskrit:
॥

अ॒न्धं तमः॒ प्रवि॑शन्ति॒ येऽसं॑भूतिमु॒पास॑ते ।

ततो॒ भूय॑ इव॒ ते तमो॒ य उ॒ संभू॑त्या र॒ताः
content.text:
Into blind darkness enter they

Who worship non-becoming ( a-sambkuti ) ;

Into darkness greater than that, as it were, they
Who delight in becoming ( sambhuti ).

content.sanskrit:
अ॒न्यदे॒वाहुः सं॑भ॒वाद॒न्यदा॑हु॒रसं॑भवात् ।

इति॑ शुश्रुम॒ धीरा॑णां॒ ये न॒स्तद्वि॑चचक्षि॒रे
content.text:
Other, indeed — they say — than origin (sambhava) !

Other — they say — than non-origin ( a-sambhava ) !

— Thus have we heard from the wise

Who to us have explained It.

Becoming and destruction a fundamental duality

content.sanskrit:
संभू॑तिं च विना॒शं च॒ यस्तद्वेदो॒भय॑ स॒ह ।

वि॒ना॒शेन॑ मृ॒त्युं ती॒र्त्वा संभू॑त्या॒मृत॑मश्नुते
content.text:
Becoming ( sambhuti ) and destruction (vinasa) —

He who this pair conjointly (saha) knows,

With destruction passing over death,

With becoming wins the immortal.

A dying person’s prayer

content.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्मये॑न॒ पात्रे॑ण स॒त्यस्यापि॑हितं॒ मुख॑म् ।

तत्त्वं पू॑ष॒न्नपावृ॑णु स॒त्यध॑र्माय दृ॒ष्टये॑
content.text:
With a golden vessel

The Real’s face is covered o’er.

That do thou, O Pushan, uncover
For one w'hose lawr is the Real to see.4

content.sanskrit:
पूषन्नेकर्षे यम सूर्य प्राजापत्य व्यूह रश्मीन्समूह तेजो॒

यत्ते॑ रू॒पं कल्या॑णतमं॒ तत्ते॑ पश्यामि

यो॒ऽसाव॒सौ पुरु॑षः॒ सो॒ऽहम॑स्मि
content.text:
O Nourisher (pusan), the sole Seer ( ekarsi ), O Con-
troller (yama), O Sun (surya), offspring of Prajapati, spread
forth thy rays ! Gather thy brilliance ( tejas ) ! 5 What is thy

content.sanskrit:
वा॒युरनि॑लम॒मृत॒मथे॒दं भस्मा॑न्त॒ शरी॑रम् ।

ॐ क्रतो॒ स्मर॑ कृ॒त स्म॑र॒ क्रतो॒ स्मर॑ कृ॒त स्म॑र
content.text:
[My] breath (vayu) to the immortal wind ( anila)\x
This body then ends in ashes ! Om !

O Purpose ( kra/u 2), remember! The deed (krla) remember!
O Purpose, remember ! The deed remember !

General prayer of petition and adoration

content.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।

यु॒यो॒ध्य॒स्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भूयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑ उ॒क्तिं विधेम
content.text:
O Agni, by a goodly path to prosperity (rat) lead us,

Thou god who knowest all the ways !

Keep far from us crooked-going sin ( etias ) ! 3

Most ample expression of adoration to thee would we render ! 4
